name: shelflens
description: A product search engine that forgives typos and explains why each result ranks where it does, with a demo store that runs entirely in your browser.

scripts.e2e: npm run storefront && playwright test --config apps/storefront/playwright.config.ts
scripts.bench: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc tsx packages/search/src/bench-cli.ts && prettier --write docs/benchmarks
scripts.bench:popover: npm run build && tsx apps/storefront/src/bench/bench-cli.ts && prettier --write docs/benchmarks
scripts.bench:sizes: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc tsx apps/storefront/src/bench/sizes-cli.ts && prettier --write docs/benchmarks
scripts.bench:cold: npm run storefront && tsx apps/storefront/src/bench/cold-visit.ts && prettier --write docs/benchmarks
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace=@shelflens/storefront
scripts.storefront: npm run build && npm run catalog -- --compact --out apps/storefront/public/catalog.json && npm run sample --workspace=@shelflens/storefront && npm run bundle --workspace=@shelflens/storefront
scripts.codegen: graphql-codegen --config packages/api/codegen.mjs && node packages/api/scripts/inline-schema.mjs && node packages/api/scripts/persist-operations.mjs && prettier --write packages/api/src/generated apps/storefront/src/generated
scripts.verify: npm run type-check --workspaces && tsc -p scripts && eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-prose.mjs && node scripts/check-node.mjs && knip --tsConfig tsconfig.build.json && vitest run
